raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Refs #40382. The primary issue there, no Ampere attention backend for a non-causal `head_dim=256` draft, is already resolved on current main by #40394. This PR fixes the remaining `num_speculative_tokens` auto-detect gap.

Serving a speculators-format draft (Eagle3, DFlash, PEAGLE, ...) through `--speculative-config` with the target as the top-level `--model` fails to start unless the user also restates `num_speculative_tokens`, even though the draft config already declares it under `speculators_config.proposal_methods[0].speculative_tokens`.

The existing auto-detect path only runs when the speculator repo itself is the top-level `--model` and `maybe_override_with_speculators` handles it. With the target as `--model` and the draft supplied via `--speculative-config`, `SpeculativeConfig.__post_init__` loads the draft as a `SpeculatorsConfig` built from `transformer_layer_config`, so the proposal-method `speculative_tokens` count is dropped before `num_speculative_tokens` can default from it.

This carries the speculators proposal count into the draft config and defaults `num_speculative_tokens` from that count when the user did not provide an explicit value. A user-provided value still takes precedence. Otherwise, non-DSpark drafts prefer `n_predict`, then `num_lookahead_tokens`. DSpark keeps its existing `block_size` / `dspark_block_size` defaults.

## Test Plan

Validated `EngineArgs.create_engine_config()`, the shared config-build path used by `vllm serve` and offline `LLM(...)` before engine startup. The repro uses target model `unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct`, speculators draft `nm-testing/Llama3_2_1B_speculator.eagle3`, and omits `num_speculative_tokens`.

## Test Result

After merging main `2067297b2f15`, the current candidate passes 47 CPU tests and the scoped pre-commit hooks:

```bash
python -m pytest tests/config/test_speculative_draft_hf_overrides.py tests/transformers_utils/test_speculators_override.py -q
```

The model configuration reproduction below is historical. Model inference and evaluation were not rerun for this candidate.

On base/main (`091386a99b9542691bb1e935ca44d0efbba6e111`), the command fails in `SpeculativeConfig` with `num_speculative_tokens` missing. With this PR's two-file diff applied to the same checkout, it creates `SpeculativeConfig(..., num_spec_tokens=3)` and sets the draft `num_lookahead_tokens` to `3`.

Environment: 1x NVIDIA RTX 4090 (sm89), Python 3.12, torch `2.11.0+cu130`. The command uses `PYTHONPATH=$PWD` so `vllm` imports from the current checkout.

Command:

```bash

import vllm
from vllm.engine.arg_utils import EngineArgs

print("commit:", subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip())
print("vllm.__file__:", vllm.__file__)
print("vllm.__version__:", getattr(vllm, "__version__", "<unknown>"))

args = EngineArgs(
    model="unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct",
    speculative_config={
        "method": "eagle3",
        "model": "nm-testing/Llama3_2_1B_speculator.eagle3",
    },
    enforce_eager=True,
    max_model_len=2048,
    gpu_memory_utilization=0.5,
)
print("EngineArgs.speculative_config:", args.speculative_config)
config = args.create_engine_config()
spec_config = config.speculative_config
print("created speculative_config:", spec_config)
print("num_speculative_tokens:", spec_config.num_speculative_tokens)
print(
    "draft num_lookahead_tokens:",
    getattr(spec_config.draft_model_config.hf_config, "num_lookahead_tokens", None),
)
PY
```

Thanks @yewentao256. I reran the failing config-build path from the PR base/main checkout (`091386a99b9542691bb1e935ca44d0efbba6e111`). The same command exits in `SpeculativeConfig` on base with `num_speculative_tokens` missing; after applying this PR's two-file diff it creates `SpeculativeConfig(..., num_spec_tokens=3)` from the draft config.

<summary>Repro command and full before/after output</summary>

Environment: 1x NVIDIA RTX 4090 (sm89), Python 3.12, torch `2.11.0+cu130`. This uses the shared config path that `vllm serve` and `LLM(...)` both call before engine startup. The target is `unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct`; the draft is `nm-testing/Llama3_2_1B_speculator.eagle3`, whose speculators proposal count is `3`.

print(

PY
